sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: French-German designer Tatjana von Stein designed hundreds of bespoke lights and furnishings for this hotel in Munich, drawing on the city's art nouveau style and its exuberant nightlife history. The Dean Munich is the latest offering from the Irish hotel chain, with 281 rooms and suites, three bars, and a signature Japanese restaurant named Ibasho. The post Tatjana von Stein blends Jugendstil style with 1980s glamour for The Dean Munich appeared first on Dezeen .
